target.source: Bijection E_q from named bit functions to coordinates below 2^q; exact two-/three-wire inverse formulas, six-wire expansion, and two-/three-wire deleted-context equality certificates.
target.formal: PrimitiveBasis q ≃ Fin(gridSize q), gridSize q=2^q. All exact statements and finite domains coincide; no physical operator or circuit conclusion.
target.decoder: The independently decoded coordinate map, tables and context codes agree with the source-first reconstruction and actual providers.
target.comparison: accepted bounded coordinate contract; no matrix/circuit/exporter bridge inferred

normalization.source: No numerical amplitudes, norm assumptions or scale parameter are claimed.
normalization.formal: Fin-valued bit functions and Nat-valued coordinates/codes; no α or normalized state vector.
normalization.decoder: Explicitly excludes amplitude/block-encoding normalization and norm premises.
normalization.comparison: same absence; 2^q is coordinate-cardinality, not normalization

registers.source: Named wires 0 through q-1; wire zero least significant. Surviving wires in increasing order receive compact weights. Empty register is legal.
registers.formal: Fin q→Fin 2; prodComm before finProdFinEquiv yields 2*tail+head. Context provider restricts to subtype wire≠target. Default branches exhaust legal Fin 2/3 cases.
registers.decoder: Recovers exact wire ordering, zero-width single state/index, carrier spellings and target-bit-independent context equality.
registers.comparison: exact agreement, including middle deletion reweighting original wire 2 by 2, not 4

oracles.formal: No oracle input, call or query-count statement in any 33 declaration.
oracles.decoder: Explicitly identifies no oracle or callable-exporter contract.
oracles.comparison: same absence; imported ambient gate semantics does not add an oracle conclusion

ancillas_phases.source: No phase/cleanliness assumptions, preparation/uncomputation or physical transformation certified.
ancillas_phases.formal: Target bit and non-target function are exact coordinates, not ancilla/phase behavior; no relevant premise or conclusion.
ancillas_phases.decoder: Explicitly excludes ancilla preparation/postselection/uncomputation and global/relative phase claims.
ancillas_phases.comparison: same absence; deleting a coordinate from the context is not erasing or resetting a physical wire

error_success.source: Exact finite identities; no measurement/probability statement.

error_success.decoder: No approximation, accumulation, precision, conditioning or success claim.
error_success.comparison: same absence; exhaustive decision is proof verification, not probabilistic success

provider_assessment.PrimitiveBasis: Actual Fin q→Fin2, not a Hilbert vector.
provider_assessment.splitPrimitiveWire: Forward pair (state target, fun wire:subtype(wire≠target) => state wire.val), inverse conditional at target. Inverse laws extensional/simp. .2 equality means exactly agreement at non-target named wires.
provider_assessment.Fin_consEquiv: Actual inverse is (head,tail); forward cons and inverse laws provided.
provider_assessment.finProdFinEquiv: Actual value is second+n*first, inverse (divNat,modNat), with division/remainder inverse proofs. After swap n=2, so LE is structural, not comment-only.
provider_assessment.prodCongr_prodComm_finCongr: Map factors, swap, cast equal bounds preserving value; 2^q*2=2^(q+1).

topology_comparison.source: Head/tail induction supports fixed inverses; complete inverse tables support projections/cases; injective surviving-bit code supports context iff; grid companions reexpress the same domain.
topology_comparison.formal: General equivalence structurally composes providers; zero/successor are rfl; fixed claims are separately exhaustively native decided rather than expressing the entire explanatory lemma graph.
topology_comparison.assessment: Obligations/prerequisites agree. Source explains mathematical proofs and explicitly discloses formal finite evaluation. This is not a claim that every source proof edge was separately formalized as a kernel-only theorem.

assumption_comparison.source: q nonnegative, finite bit functions, bounded indices, legal targets.
assumption_comparison.formal: Exactly the typed finite carriers; modulo/bound witnesses constructed internally, not user premises.
assumption_comparison.empty_register: No positivity premise: Fin0 has no wires, but gridSize0=1 has one index; no legal target inhabits Fin0.
assumption_comparison.target_bits: No condition of equality at target; no left≠right or other extra fixed-width premise.
assumption_comparison.trust: 24 fixed theorems require current native evaluator/compiler/runtime axioms, as explicitly retained by lesson and this review.

proof_trust.fresh_probe: Own ignored probe pasted actual current module, importing only PrimitiveSemantics, then @-checked and #print-axioms-checked all 33; exit0. Not sole reliance on cached target .olean.
proof_trust.standard_axioms: Equivalence and zero/successor: propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound; explicit bits definitions: propext, Quot.sound; four context arithmetic definitions: none; native theorem declarations add exact fresh declaration-specific axioms.
proof_trust.native_path: Read actual Lean4.33 Native.lean and Decide.lean. +revert closes inputs; mkDecide forms Bool; nativeEqTrue compiles it via addAndCompile and evaluates via unsafe evalConst. On true it inserts a safe axiom asserting Bool=true; of_decide_eq_true uses that axiom. Kernel checking does not independently enumerate the Bool.
